title: What are zoom tiles?
marker: OBS opener · lower left or full screen
lines: What are zoom tiles?
Think about the last time you zoomed into Google Maps.
You went from a region to a street.

title: A stack of zoom levels
lines: Under the hood, there’s a stack of zoom levels.
At level zero, the whole world fits in one tile.
The next level uses four tiles.
Zoom again, and there are sixteen.

title: Same place, more detail
lines: As you zoom in, the map loads a more detailed set of tiles.
Follow this bridge. The river stays in the same place.
Now you can see the streets beside it.
That consistency is what makes zooming useful.

title: Maps beyond Earth
marker: Animation · knowledge, imaginary and game worlds
lines: With zTiles, you can build a stack like that for other kinds of maps.
It could be a map of science, history, or the internet.
Or an imaginary place, like Middle-earth or a game world.

title: Explore a map of science
marker: Actual World Explorer capture · keep full frame
lines: Here’s a map of science in the zTiles prototype.
At the overview, you can see the main fields.
Search for physics, then zoom in.
Now you can explore mechanics and other subfields.

title: What would you map?
lines: The idea is to give you a way to explore worlds at your own pace.
Start with the big picture. Follow what interests you.
What kind of world would you map?
